capabilities: Open the active file in Cursor via its CLI
Reuse an existing Cursor window or spawn a new one
Focus a configured .code-workspace when the file belongs to it
Preserve the cursor position for files with an active text editor
Configure CLI path, workspace targeting, vault staging, and OS fallbacks
extras: Desktop-only (mobile lacks required APIs); currently only Cursor is supported (VSCode 'coming soon'); formally tested on macOS only; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand the currently open file off to an external IDE or editor.

relations.evidence: Open the current Obsidian file in your IDE of choice.

summary: Opens the active vault file in Cursor via its CLI, reusing windows, optionally focusing a workspace, and preserving the cursor position.
